XianGu.title: Immortal Gu
XianGu.description: A rank 6 or higher Gu. Across the run, all players may permanently own only one Immortal Gu with the same card identity. This rule is independent of [gold]Unique[/gold].

CuiDong.title: Activation
CuiDong.description: Gu cards can be played directly from the Gu Hand; they enter the recovery pile after use.

HuiFu.title: Recovery
HuiFu.description: After all activations are spent, the Gu enters recovery and returns to the Gu pile after the listed number of turns.

HeLian.title: Fusion
HeLian.description: Consumes the specified Gu materials to refine a new Gu. Its rank follows the recipe and it is normally excluded from rewards.

KeXue.title: Bloodthirst
KeXue.description: Spend the listed amount of Blood Essence to use or empower the corresponding effect.

ZiShi.title: Self-Devour
ZiShi.description: When paying Bloodthirst, lose 2 HP for each missing Blood Essence instead; this cannot reduce HP below 1.

XueQi.title: Blood Qi
XueQi.description: Adapts to the host: damage and Bleed, Block and Blood Essence, or direct Blood Essence. Higher ranks trigger multiple times.

YueXiang.title: Moon Phase
YueXiang.description: Blood Moon advances Crescent → Waxing → Full. Each complete host resolution advances one phase.

XueTai.title: Blood Fetus
XueTai.description: A compound parasite. Each trigger adapts to the host and gains Fetal Movement; it hatches at 3.

TaiDong.title: Fetal Movement
TaiDong.description: Blood Fetus maturity. It hatches at 3; devouring another parasite can inherit 1–2 progress.

PoTai.title: Rupture
PoTai.description: If an immature parasitized host enters Exhaust, remove the parasite and gain 1 Blood Essence without resolving remaining effects.

FuHua.title: Hatch
FuHua.description: The final resolution after a parasite completes its last trigger, after which it is removed.

TunJi.title: Devour Parasite
TunJi.description: Blood Fetus replaces Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite and inherits 1–2 Fetal Movement.

ZongEDu.title: Shared Pool
ZongEDu.description: AoE damage, Bleed, or Blood Marks are shared totals divided among living enemies, not copied per enemy.

CanYue.title: Crescent
CanYue.description: Moon Phase stage 1. Resolve the lower shared damage and Bleed pool, then advance to Waxing.

YingYue.title: Waxing
YingYue.description: Moon Phase stage 2. Resolve the middle shared pool and possible Blood Marks, then advance to Full.

ManYue.title: Full Moon
ManYue.description: Final Moon Phase. Resolve the largest shared pool and hatch; rank 6+ refunds Blood Essence and rank 9 also draws.

YiChu.title: Overflow
YiChu.description: When a resource gain exceeds its cap, the amount that could not be gained is converted into another benefit as stated by the card.

ZhuiJi.title: Pursuit
ZhuiJi.description: If the target dies, unresolved remaining hits move to another living enemy.

YaoHua1.title: Illumination 1
YaoHua1.description: When you have at least 1 Radiance, automatically spend 1 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua2.title: Illumination 2
YaoHua2.description: When you have at least 2 Radiance, automatically spend 2 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua3.title: Illumination 3
YaoHua3.description: When you have at least 3 Radiance, automatically spend 3 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua4.title: Illumination 4
YaoHua4.description: When you have at least 4 Radiance, automatically spend 4 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua5.title: Illumination 5
YaoHua5.description: When you have at least 5 Radiance, automatically spend 5 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua6.title: Illumination 6
YaoHua6.description: When you have at least 6 Radiance, automatically spend 6 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua7.title: Illumination 7
YaoHua7.description: When you have at least 7 Radiance, automatically spend 7 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua8.title: Illumination 8
YaoHua8.description: When you have at least 8 Radiance, automatically spend 8 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

YaoHua9.title: Illumination 9
YaoHua9.description: When you have at least 9 Radiance, automatically spend 9 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.

ShiHai1.title: Devour Remains 1
ShiHai1.description: Choose up to 1 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.

ShiHai2.title: Devour Remains 2
ShiHai2.description: Choose up to 2 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.

ShiHai3.title: Devour Remains 3
ShiHai3.description: Choose up to 3 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.

cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_SHA_ZHAO_TUI_YAN.descri: Retain. First choose a craftable Killer Move, then choose matching Gu Worm materials. If successful, pay the derivation essence to gain the Killer Move; otherwise the card returns to your hand.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_SHI_GU.description: Gain {Dexterity:diff()} temporary [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. {BlockRetentionTurns:cond:>0?For the next {BlockRetentionTurns} turn(s), your Block is not removed at the start of your turn.|}
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_QING_TI_XIAN_YUAN.descr: Retain as immortal essence. Provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_HONG_ZAO_XIAN_YUAN.desc: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two Green Grape essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_BAI_LI_XIAN_YUAN.descri: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two Red Date essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_HUANG_XING_XIAN_YUAN.de: Retain as immortal essence. Equals two White Litchi essences and provides {RemainingActivationUnits}/{ActivationUnits} rank-6 activation units; Exhaust this card when depleted.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_REPLACE_GU_WORM.selecti: Your {Capacity}-card Gu capacity is full. Choose an existing Gu Worm to replace to obtain [gold]{NewCard}[/gold].
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_QI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] {BloodCost}, [gold]Self-Devour[/gold]. Choose 1 normal card in your hand and implant [gold]Blood Qi[/gold].
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_YUE_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Fusion[/gold]; [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 2: implant [gold]Moon Phase[/gold]. Three-stage [gold]Shared Pools[/gold]—damage {CrescentBase}+{CrescentScale}X / {WaxingBase}+{WaxingScale}X / {FullBase}+{FullScale}X; Bleed {CrescentBleed}/{WaxingBleed}/{FullBleed}; Marks {CrescentMarks}/{WaxingMarks}/{FullMarks}. X is host Energy spent.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_CHI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Gain {XueYuanPower:diff()} [gold]Blood Essence[/gold]; convert each [gold]Overflow[/gold] into {OverflowBlock} Block.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_PI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Gain {Block:diff()} Block; [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 1: gain {EmpoweredBlock} more. Each [gold]Blood Skull[/gold] adds 2 Block.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_LU_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Gain {Block:diff()} Block; [gold]Devour Remains {MaxAbsorb}[/gold]: each grants 1 [gold]Blood Skull[/gold], or heals {Heal:diff()} HP at the cap.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_DAO_CHI_XUE_FU_GU.descr: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. Add a same-rank [gold]Blade-Wing Blood Bat[/gold]; [gold]Devour Remains 2[/gold]: add a [gold]Blade-Wing Blood Bat Swarm[/gold] instead.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_TAI_GU.description: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Fusion[/gold]; [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 2, [gold]Self-Devour[/gold]: implant [gold]Blood Fetus[/gold], which can [gold]Devour Parasite[/gold] and [gold]Hatches[/gold] after 3 [gold]Fetal Movement[/gold].
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_FU_WANG_GU.descript: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Devour Remains 2[/gold]: add a same-rank [gold]Blood Bat King[/gold]; each adds 2 hits, and 2 grants [gold]Pursuit[/gold]. Resolve [gold]Blood Skull[/gold].
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_XUE_HE_JIA_GU.descripti: [gold]Rank {Rank}[/gold]. [gold]Recover[/gold] {RecoveryTurns}. [gold]Blood River[/gold]: below 4 Essence, gain {LowBloodGain} Essence and {LowBlock} Block; otherwise [gold]Bloodthirst[/gold] 2 for {HighBlock} Block, then half next turn. Each [gold]Blood Skull[/gold] adds 2 Block.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_WAN_HAI_GUI_CHAO.descri: [gold]Devour Remains 3[/gold]. Split a {Damage:diff()} + {DamagePerRemains} per Remains damage pool among all enemies. Gain {Block:diff()} + {BlockPerRemains} Block per Remains.
Enchantment · Moon Phase (Rank {Rank} · Crescent): {TriggersRemaining} trigger(s) remain; advances after the host is played.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_PARASITE_WAXING_MOON.ex: Enchantment · Moon Phase (Rank {Rank} · Waxing): {TriggersRemaining} trigger(s) remain; advances after the host is played.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_PARASITE_FULL_MOON.extr: Enchantment · Moon Phase (Rank {Rank} · Full): {TriggersRemaining} trigger(s) remain; hatches after the host is played.
cardDescriptionOverrides.GU_ZHEN_REN_CARD_PARASITE_BLOOD_FETUS.ex: Enchantment · Blood Fetus (Rank {Rank}): {Stage}/3 Fetal Movement, {TriggersRemaining} trigger(s) remain; hatches at 3.

restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.name: Gu Refinement
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.descriptio: First select 1 eligible Gu Worm. If it is mortal, you may select up to 2 additional mortal Gu Worms (3 total); if it is immortal, you may select up to 1 additional immortal Gu Worm (2 total). Each selected Gu Worm gains one rank, including rank 5 to rank 6. Confirming with 0 selected cancels. Each rest site allows one successful refinement.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.selectionP: Select the first Gu Worm to refine. Then select up to 2 more of the same kind; mortal Gu can total 3 and immortal Gu can total 2.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.name: Gu Fusion
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.description: First select a currently craftable Gu card, then select Gu Worm materials matching that target. Materials are consumed and the result is created only when both types and quantities match; failed attempts do not consume the use. Fusion can succeed once per rest site.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.selectionProm: Select materials matching the target Gu card, then confirm.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_HE_LIAN.targetSelecti: First select the Gu card to craft. Only materials that can match the target will be shown next.
restSiteLocalizationFallbacks.OPTION_GU_ZHEN_REN_GU_RANK_UP.secondMort: Select additional Gu Worms of the same kind (up to 2 mortal or 1 immortal), or confirm with 0 selected.

combatInterfaceLocalizationFallbacks.text: Gu Storage Pile
Stores up to 5 currently usable Gu Worms. When space is available, recovered Gu are drawn in recovery order from the Gu Recovery Pile. Killer Move deduction can use only materials in this pile.
There are no Gu Worms available in the Gu Storage Pile.
Select Gu Worm materials matching the selected Killer Move, then confirm.
First select the Killer Move to deduce. Only matching materials will be shown next.
Gu Recovery Pile

Stores cooling Gu and recovered Gu waiting because the Gu Hand is full. At turn start, vacancies are filled at random. Left-click to inspect; right-click and spend 1 Energy to deduce a Killer Move using materials only from the Gu Hand.
The Gu Recovery Pile is empty.
Brilliance

A character resource capped at 9. Brilliance does not disappear at end of turn; Light Path cards can gain or spend it. Refraction: when the previous standard card you played has a different type, a Light Path card gains 1 Brilliance (up to 3 per turn).
Illumination Break
The next time a single hit from an Attack card deals damage, take 3 additional damage and remove 1 Illumination Break. Multi-hit attacks can consume multiple stacks.
Blood Essence
A personal character resource capped at 12. Only Blood Path Gu cards and their exclusive debuffs can gain or spend Blood Essence.
Blood Mark

After taking unblocked damage from the applier’s Blood Path Gu Attack, remove 1 Blood Mark and lose 3 additional HP. Across the battlefield, each CardPlay grants at most 1 Blood Essence; Replay starts a new CardPlay.
Bleed
At the end of the owner’s turn, remove 1 Bleed, grant the applier 1 Blood Essence, and deal 3 damage to the owner.
Blood Qi Recovery
At the start of your next turn, heal {Amount} HP, then remove this effect.
Primeval Essence

Primeval essence stored in a Gu Master's aperture. Begin each combat with the amount granted by your aperture rank (rank 1: 4, rank 9: 14); from turn 2 onward, restore 2-5 each turn by rank (1-2: 2, 3-5: 3, 6-7: 4, 8-9: 5). Maximum essence rises with aperture rank: 5/6/7/8/9/11/12/13/15.
Blood Skull
Up to 3 stacks. Each strengthens Blood Path parasites, defenses, and Blade-Wing Blood Bat multi-hit attacks, but does not increase resource generation.
Blood Parasite
{Amount} card(s) carry an unresolved Blood Path parasite. The parasite triggers after the host’s final play and is then removed.
Blood River After-Armor
At the start of your next turn, gain {Amount} Block, then remove this effect.
Shine
The first hit of your next Light Path Attack deals {Amount} more damage. Multi-hit attacks gain this bonus only once.
